$schema.description: JSON Schema pointer for editor autocomplete; ignored by the editor.

palette.description: Editor palette id — a built-in or a custom theme document.

material.description: Editor material id (`classic`, `glass`, or one a style bundle carries).

icons.description: Editor icon set id (`default`, or one a style bundle carries).

workspaceTabs.description: The workspace tab strip in the top bar (Blender's); hidden unless a style shows it.

inspector.description: Inspector presentation: the narrow docked column or a properties panel.

telemetry.description: The top bar's runtime telemetry cluster: the frame-rate readout, its sparkline and the audio meter. The Profiler utility is the same information's other door.

hierarchyTypeSuffix.description: The `·TypeName` a component-instance row prints after its name in the hierarchy. Hidden leaves the row its name alone, the way Blender's Outliner does; the type stays reachable through the row's own tooltip and the inspector.

hierarchyInstanceRule.description: The dotted rule a component-instance row draws under its name in the hierarchy. Hidden leaves the name unmarked, the way Blender's Outliner does; the fact stays reachable through the row's own tooltip, its source actions and the inspector.

hierarchyRestrictions.description: Which restriction columns a hierarchy row carries at its right edge: this editor's selection lock beside the eye, or Blender's default filter — the eye in its own column with the render column reserved and blank, three.js having one visibility flag for viewport and render alike.

regions.description: Which chrome regions a style bundle shows or hides.

play.description: How the editor presents Play mode.

keepPanelsVisible.description: Keep editor panels visible when starting Play, instead of letting an immersive workspace hide them. Turning this on during Play restores the panels; turning it off applies on the next Play.

devicePreview.description: The device frame the Game document previews in.

touch.description: Touch emulation override; null follows the preset.

description: Editor settings — the user layer and the project layer share this shape.
